title: Handle 'just give us a pilot'
objective: Role-play a champion who says workshops are a delay.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: The loudest voice in the room isn't always the best evidence. Structure the session so that every relevant role contributes.

Glean's Visioning playbook recommends small sessions, ideally one to three participants, to encourage candor and focus, with additional sessions by line of business if needed. When a larger group can't be avoided:

items: Use structured turns, so each role answers the same question.
Ask for silent writing before discussion.
Invite specific roles: "What does this look like for a new agent?"

blocks.x: A senior leader's opinion matters. It isn't the same as a front-line workflow observation, so record both and label them. When someone pulls toward their pet topic, park it visibly with an owner and return to the agenda.

blocks.label: Boundary
blocks.x: Never put participants on the spot about sensitive issues. Respect consent, privacy, and organizational norms.
When one voice dominates, change the format rather than confronting the person.

blocks.title: Techniques for balanced participation
blocks.alt: Four cards naming techniques for balanced participation: direct questions to specific roles, use silent writing before discussion, use a parking lot for off-topic items, and follow up separately with quieter participants.

items.label: Direct by role
items.detail: Ask the people who do the work

items.label: Parking lot
items.detail: Capture off-topic items, with an owner

items.label: Separate follow-up
items.detail: Hear quieter voices one to one

practice.x: A senior manager answers every question meant for front-line agents. What do you do?

worked.x: Thank them and capture their view. Then run a structured round: "I'd like to hear from each of you about the last access case you handled." If needed, schedule a separate, consented interview with the agents.
Record which input was observed behavior and which was a leadership view.
